theme: 3 terms on how views nest: the child, the parent, and the tree they form

terms.definition: A view that sits inside another view.
terms.example: Add the label as a Subview of the card.

terms.definition: The view that directly contains another view.
terms.example: If the Superview is nil, the view isn't on screen yet.

terms.definition: The tree of views, where every view sits inside a parent and can hold its own children.
terms.example: Open the View Hierarchy debugger to see which view covers the button.

video.title: Subview, Superview & View Hierarchy | Day 101
video.description:
Learn to explain how views sit inside each other and why order matters: Subview, Superview & View Hierarchy, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Subview - A view that sits inside another view.
Superview - The view that directly contains another view.
View Hierarchy - The tree of views, where every view sits inside a parent and can hold its own children.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: iOS Subview, Superview & View Hierarchy | Day 101
landscape.description:
Explain Subview, Superview & View Hierarchy in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
서브뷰, 슈퍼뷰, 뷰 계층 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Subview - A view that sits inside another view.
한국어: 서브뷰: 다른 뷰 안에 들어 있는 뷰

Superview - The view that directly contains another view.
한국어: 슈퍼뷰: 다른 뷰를 바로 담고 있는 뷰

View Hierarchy - The tree of views, where every view sits inside a parent and can hold its own children.
한국어: 뷰 계층: 모든 뷰가 부모 안에 있고 자신의 자식도 가질 수 있는 뷰의 트리 구조

dialogue.title: The badge follows the wrong view

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, my badge now moves with the photo, not with the card.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Look at the last line. You added the badge to the photo.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So the photo is now its Superview?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. A view has only one Superview, so it left the card.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I wanted both as Subviews of the card.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then remove the last line. The card holds two Subviews.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. In the View Hierarchy, a later Subview is drawn on top.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good. The badge is added after the photo, so it's on top.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Perfect. Use the debugger if the View Hierarchy looks strange.
Every label on the card is a Subview.
